dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: 今日はご相談にお越し頂きありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: 初めに、ご年齢と性別、ご相談の中でなんとお呼びしたら良いかを教えて下さい。
dialogue.content: To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like me to call you during our session?

dialogue.origin: 20代　女性　はなです
dialogue.content: I'm in my 20s, female, and you can call me Hana.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。はなさん、今日はどの様なご相談でお越し頂きましたか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. Hana, what brings you in for a consultation today?

dialogue.origin: 高校時代の友だちとけんかしたんです
dialogue.content: I had a fight with a friend from high school.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、ケンカは嫌なものですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. Fights can be unpleasant, can't they?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 高校時代のお友達というと、今はどの様な語関係ですか？
dialogue.content: When you say a friend from high school, what is your relationship like now?

dialogue.origin: ご関係ミスタッチごめんなさい
dialogue.content: Sorry for the typo, I meant 'relationship.'

dialogue.origin: たまに会って、お茶するくらいかな
dialogue.content: We occasionally meet up for tea or something like that, I suppose.

dialogue.origin: 卒業して2年たってもお茶ができるお友達なのですね。
dialogue.content: So you're friends who can still have tea together even two years after graduating.

dialogue.origin: その喧嘩のことでご相談いただくのは、どの様な事でお悩みなのですか？
dialogue.content: What specifically about this fight is troubling you?

dialogue.origin: いえ、まぁ、5年かな、ケンカしてから会ってません
dialogue.content: No, well, it's been about 5 years, I think. We haven't seen each other since the fight.

dialogue.origin: ごめんなさい、確認です。ケンカなさったのは五年前の事なのですか？
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, just to confirm: Did the fight happen five years ago?

dialogue.origin: 卒業してからは５年くらいです
dialogue.content: It's been about five years since we graduated.

dialogue.origin: 先週、ケンカしたきり
dialogue.content: We had a fight last week,

dialogue.origin: 会ってません
dialogue.content: and we haven't seen each other since.

dialogue.origin: ケンカなさった事をもう少し詳しくお話ししていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me a bit more about the fight?

dialogue.origin: いつもみたいに仕事のこととか、聞いてたんですけど
dialogue.content: I was asking her about work and such like I usually do,

dialogue.origin: なんだか
dialogue.content: but somehow...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I'm listening.

dialogue.origin: お気に召さなかったらしくて、、、
dialogue.content: It seems she didn't like it...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そのまま、別れたきりなんです
dialogue.content: We just parted ways like that, and that was it.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、その時の会話をお友達がお気に召さなかったのだなと感じたのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you felt that your friend didn't like the conversation at that time.

dialogue.origin: 私なりにアドバイスしたつもりだったんですけど
dialogue.content: I thought I was offering advice in my own way, but...

dialogue.origin: なるほど、　お友達にアドバイスをする会話だったという事でしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. So it was a conversation where you were giving your friend advice?

dialogue.origin: わかりません
dialogue.content: I'm not sure.

dialogue.origin: アドバイスは余計な事だったのかな？
dialogue.content: Maybe the advice was unnecessary?

dialogue.origin: それは、話の運びが分らないので、何とも言えないのですが、
dialogue.content: It's hard to say without knowing how the conversation unfolded,

dialogue.origin: あなたがアドバイスをなさったのは相手の方のことを思っての会話だったと思います。
dialogue.content: but I believe you offered that advice out of concern for your friend.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なので、余計だとは、思いませんよ。
dialogue.content: So, I don't think it was unnecessary.

dialogue.origin: いつもお仕事のこととかを聞いていると話してくださいましたが、いつも聞き手がはなさんということなのですか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned that you usually ask about work and such—does that mean you're usually the one listening?

dialogue.origin: 仕事の話が出るのは、彼女の方からが多いかも
dialogue.content: She's usually the one who brings up work, I think.

dialogue.origin: その時は、たまたまかな
dialogue.content: That time, I think it was just by chance.

dialogue.origin: これまでに、こういう時はお気に召さないのだなと感じたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you ever felt before that in situations like this, certain things don't sit well with her?

dialogue.origin: それはあんまり思い出せないけど
dialogue.content: I can't really recall anything like that, but...

dialogue.origin: 好みとか、感じる事がちがうなーって思うことは時々
dialogue.content: But I do sometimes think that our tastes and the way we feel about things are different.

dialogue.origin: 彼女とは、感じ方が違うと思われている、客観的に判断ができていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: So you feel that you and she perceive things differently. You seem to be able to judge that objectively.

dialogue.origin: 少し戻りますが、その時は、たまたまかな、のたまたまは、何がたまたまなのか教えてください。
dialogue.content: Going back a bit, when you said it was 'just by chance' that time, could you tell me what you meant by 'by chance'?

dialogue.origin: うーんいつも差し障りのない趣味の話とかが多いからかな
dialogue.content: Hmm, maybe it's because we usually talk about harmless things like hobbies.

dialogue.origin: おしゃべりを楽しむことを種になさっているのですね。お茶するってそれが楽しいですよね。
dialogue.content: So you mainly enjoy chatting. That's the fun part of having tea, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 種は主でしたごめんなさい
dialogue.content: Sorry, that was a typo for 'main.'

dialogue.origin: ほんと、その日は仕事のことが話になっただけ
dialogue.content: Really, it was just that work came up in conversation that day.

dialogue.origin: たまたまお仕事のお話が出て、アドバイスをなさったのは、お仕事の悩みを話してくださったから？
dialogue.content: Work happened to come up, and you offered advice because she shared a work-related concern?

dialogue.origin: 彼女にとっては悩みという程でもなかったかもだけど、
dialogue.content: It might not have been a real 'concern' for her, but...

dialogue.origin: 珍しくきいてきたから？、
dialogue.content: Maybe because she asked, which was unusual?

dialogue.origin: 何気に話しただけなんだけど
dialogue.content: I just mentioned it casually.

dialogue.origin: いつもは聞いてこないのに、そうされたので、何か言ってあげなくてはと思われたのでしょうか？お友達ですものね。
dialogue.content: Since she doesn't usually ask, did you feel you had to say something? She is your friend, after all.

dialogue.origin: それも、はなさんとしては、何気なく、それも気遣いですよね。
dialogue.content: And from your perspective, Hana, you said it casually, but that in itself is a form of consideration, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですねフツーにそう思っただけ
dialogue.content: Right, that's just what I thought.

dialogue.origin: 思った事を伝えただけ
dialogue.content: I just said what I thought.

dialogue.origin: それをケンカと捉える形になったのは、その後、何かありましたか？
dialogue.content: Did something happen afterwards that made you perceive it as a fight?

dialogue.origin: なんか、空気違うなって思って、いつも別れた後はLINEとかスタンプ来るのに、未だ何にも来ない
dialogue.content: I felt the vibe was different, and usually after we part ways, she sends a LINE message or a sticker, but I haven't received anything yet.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、それ以来、別れた後のLINEがこないと、それは気になりますよね。
dialogue.content: I see. Not receiving the usual LINE message after you parted—that would be concerning, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: サヨナラする時も、態度に違和感があったのですね？
dialogue.content: So you felt something was off about her attitude when you said goodbye, too?

dialogue.origin: なんか、そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, I guess so.

dialogue.origin: はなさんからはLINEで何か送信なさったのですか？
dialogue.content: Did you send her anything on LINE?

dialogue.origin: いいえ、してません
dialogue.content: No, I haven't.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。いつもはなさんからはしないのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Do you usually not send the first message?

dialogue.origin: いつもは私からもしてます
dialogue.content: I usually do send something too.

dialogue.origin: 今回、はなさんから送信しないでいるお気持ちは、どんな？
dialogue.content: How are you feeling about not sending anything this time?

dialogue.origin: うーんなんて返信したらいいか、わかんない
dialogue.content: Hmm, I don't know what to write.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいと思いますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think I should do?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、はなさんがお茶会から嫌な感じで立ち去ってしまったら、どんな気持ちになりますか？
dialogue.content: Well, how would you feel if you were the one who left the tea meeting feeling upset?

dialogue.origin: 自分が、ですか？
dialogue.content: Me, you mean?

dialogue.origin: はいもしはなさんが、何かアドバイスしてもらったけど、瞬間、ちょっと頭に来て、自分の気持ちを整えられなくて、顔や態度に出ちゃったな、
dialogue.content: Yes. Suppose you received some advice, and for a moment you got a little upset, couldn't compose yourself, and it showed on your face and in your attitude—

dialogue.origin: でも、今は、このまま去りたい
dialogue.content: but for now, you just want to leave things as they are,

dialogue.origin: 気まずい、と思ってさったとしたら、
dialogue.content: thinking 'this is awkward,' and you left—

dialogue.origin: じぶんのことが嫌いになっちゃうと思います
dialogue.content: I think I'd end up disliking myself.

dialogue.origin: LINEもいつもの様には送れない？
dialogue.content: And you wouldn't be able to send a LINE message like usual?

dialogue.origin: うーん、いつもとはちがうからなーなんて書けばいいんだろ
dialogue.content: Hmm, since it's different from usual, I wonder what I should write.

dialogue.origin: 悩んでしまいますよね
dialogue.content: You'd be troubled by it, wouldn't you?

dialogue.origin: お友達に気遣いするから、なおのこと、文章を考えてしまいますよね
dialogue.content: Because you're considerate of your friend, you end up thinking even more carefully about what to write, don't you?

dialogue.origin: どうしようかと悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm worried about what to do.

dialogue.origin: 声をかけることに悩むのは、大切なお友達だからこそだと思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: I think the reason you're struggling with reaching out is precisely because she's an important friend to you. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そう思ってたんだけど
dialogue.content: That's what I thought, but...

dialogue.origin: なんか
dialogue.content: somehow...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 違うかも、って思ってます
dialogue.content: I'm starting to think that maybe that's not it.

dialogue.origin: 違うかもって思ったのですね。おや？って？
dialogue.content: So you thought it might be different. Like, 'Huh?'

dialogue.origin: それは、初めてのことですか？
dialogue.content: Is this the first time you've felt that way?

dialogue.origin: ここまで違和感は感じてなかったけど
dialogue.content: I haven't felt this sense of unease to this extent before,

dialogue.origin: 面白いって思うツボが違うのも楽しいかなとは思ってたので
dialogue.content: because I used to think it was fun that we had different senses of humor,

dialogue.origin: そんなには気にしていなかったのかも
dialogue.content: so maybe I didn't pay that much attention to it.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、人はいろんな人がいて、それが自分のことを気付かせてくれたりしますよね。
dialogue.content: That's right. There are all kinds of people, and they can help us realize things about ourselves, can't they?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's true.

dialogue.origin: 五年もお茶会のできるお友達はこれからも人生に大切なお友達だと思います。
dialogue.content: A friend you can have tea with for five years will likely continue to be an important friend in your life.

dialogue.origin: そうですか
dialogue.content: Is that so?

dialogue.origin: あなたも、お友達も、それぞれの社会で、経験することもあり、趣味の違いも広がっていくかもしれません。
dialogue.content: You and your friend will both have your own experiences in your respective worlds, and your differences in interests may grow.

dialogue.origin: だから、それを認め合ったり、批判しあってりできる様になったら、一緒に成長できますね。
dialogue.content: So, if you can learn to acknowledge and even critique those differences with each other, you can grow together.

dialogue.origin: 一緒に成長できるのならいいですけど、、、
dialogue.content: It would be nice if we could grow together, but...

dialogue.origin: ギクシャクを何回も繰り返すと思いますが、
dialogue.content: I think there will be some awkward moments along the way, but...

dialogue.origin: 今は、不機嫌に立ち去ったお友達の方が、どうしたら良いかと悩んでいるかもしれないと思うのですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: For now, I think it might be your friend, the one who left in a bad mood, who is wondering what to do. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そうかなぁ
dialogue.content: I wonder...

dialogue.origin: 私がアドバイスしたことについて？
dialogue.content: About the advice I gave?

dialogue.origin: 雰囲気を悪くして立ち去ってしまって、あなたに不快な感じを残したかも、LINEをなんて送ったら良いかな？って
dialogue.content: She might be thinking, 'I made the atmosphere awkward and left her with a bad feeling. What should I write in my LINE message?'

dialogue.origin: そうですよねその点では、気持ち軽くしてあげたらいいとは思います
dialogue.content: You're right. In that sense, I do think it would be good to put her at ease.

dialogue.origin: 思いやりがありますね！
dialogue.content: That's very thoughtful of you!

dialogue.origin: そんなことありません
dialogue.content: Not really.

dialogue.origin: お友達の気持ちを軽くしてあげるには、どうしてる？の一言でも、あなたから送って差し上げたら、叶うと思うのですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: To put your friend's mind at ease, I think sending even a simple message from you like, 'How are you doing?' would accomplish that. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: やっぱり、そうしておけばいいですよね
dialogue.content: I guess I should do that, after all.

dialogue.origin: ケンカをしてしまって、というご相談にいらしたところに、このままではいけないというあなたの前向きな気持ちを受け取りました。
dialogue.content: You came in for a consultation about a fight, and in that, I can sense your positive attitude that you don't want to leave things as they are.

dialogue.origin: 自分だったら、こんな言葉をもらえたら心が救われる、と思う言葉を送ってあげてみてはいかがでしょう？
dialogue.content: How about sending her the kind of words that you yourself would find comforting if you were in her shoes?

dialogue.origin: とりあえず、送ってはみます
dialogue.content: I'll try sending something, for now.

dialogue.origin: でも
dialogue.content: But...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: この先、付き合いを続けるかどうかを迷っています
dialogue.content: I'm not sure whether to continue this friendship.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、付き合うかどうかを迷っているということですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so you're undecided about whether to continue the friendship.

dialogue.origin: なんで、
dialogue.content: Why...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: そもそもどうしようかと
dialogue.content: I mean, in the first place, I'm not sure what to do at all.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: でも、お別れするにしても、そのお別れの仕方が、嫌な印象を抱き続けてのままでは無い方がいいと思うのですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: But even if you do decide to part ways, I think it's better not to do it in a way that leaves you both with lasting negative feelings. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: それは、そうですね
dialogue.content: That's true.

dialogue.origin: とりあえず、この嫌な気持ちを解消する行動をとって、その後、またそれぞれ違う方向に歩まれる中で、お悩み事が生じたら、またいつでもご相談にいらしてください。
dialogue.content: For now, please take action to resolve these unpleasant feelings. After that, as you each continue on your separate paths, if any other concerns arise, please feel free to come back for a consultation anytime.

dialogue.origin: 嫌な印象じゃない方がいいってことでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So you mean it's better not to leave a bad impression?

dialogue.origin: 時間ですね
dialogue.content: Oh, it's time.

dialogue.origin: 今日はありがとうございました。それではカウンセリングを終了致します。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time today. We will now conclude the counseling session.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

topic.sub: 高校時代の友人との喧嘩問題
